countries_thin_or_null: Lebanon — CAS continues to publish national accounts (SNA 2008) and monthly CPI despite crisis strain since 2019-20; limited public detailed methodology pages beyond SNA naming and ongoing releases

Qatar — institutional transition from Planning and Statistics Authority (PSA) to National Planning Council / National Statistics Center (2024-2025); older DSBB referenced 1993 SNA; current e-GDDS participation confirmed but detailed current SNA edition less explicitly documented in primary pages found
Kuwait — CSB national accounts framework historically 1993 SNA with noted move toward 2008; e-GDDS participation clear via NSDP

proposed_reports.title: GCC Statistical Centre (GCC-Stat)
proposed_reports.publisher: Statistical Centre of the Cooperation Council for the Arab States of the Gulf
proposed_reports.description: Regional statistical body providing common official pool of statistics and data for GCC member states (UAE, Bahrain, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar, Kuwait); established 2011, Charter approved 2012; coordinates harmonisation and produces regional indicators.

proposed_reports.title: Department of Statistics (DoS / DOS)
proposed_reports.publisher: Department of Statistics, Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan
proposed_reports.description: Official national statistics office of Jordan, responsible for collecting, analyzing, and disseminating official statistics including national accounts, CPI, population, and surveys since 1949 under Public Statistics Law.

proposed_reports.title: Jordan National Accounts (Annual and Quarterly GDP)
proposed_reports.description: Annual and quarterly GDP estimates at current and constant prices by production, expenditure and income approaches; includes supply-use and input-output tables; base year updates (e.g. 2023=100).

proposed_reports.title: Jordan Consumer Price Index (CPI)
proposed_reports.description: Monthly consumer price index measuring changes in prices of goods and services purchased by households; weights from Household Income and Expenditure Survey; Laspeyres formula.

proposed_reports.title: Central Administration of Statistics (CAS)
proposed_reports.publisher: Central Administration of Statistics, Presidency of the Council of Ministers, Lebanese Republic
proposed_reports.description: Official national statistics office of Lebanon responsible for national accounts, CPI, surveys, censuses and official indicators; continues operations under economic and crisis strain.

proposed_reports.title: Lebanon National Accounts Estimates
proposed_reports.description: Annual (and some quarterly) national accounts estimates including nominal and real GDP; recent releases cover 2022-2023 and 2024 estimates with crisis adjustments.

proposed_reports.title: Lebanon Consumer Price Index (CPI)
proposed_reports.description: Monthly CPI series tracking inflation; continues to be published regularly (e.g. July 2026 YoY +15.69%).

proposed_reports.title: Central Statistical Bureau (CSB)
proposed_reports.publisher: Central Statistical Bureau, State of Kuwait
proposed_reports.description: Official national statistics office of Kuwait (autonomous under Deputy Prime Minister/State Minister for Development Affairs); responsible for national accounts, CPI, censuses and statistical yearbooks.

proposed_reports.title: Kuwait Gross Domestic Product Estimates
proposed_reports.description: Annual and quarterly GDP estimates at current and constant prices; time series published by CSB.

proposed_reports.title: Kuwait Consumer Price Index
proposed_reports.description: Monthly and annual consumer price index numbers compiled and disseminated by CSB.

proposed_reports.title: National Statistics Center (under National Planning Council)
proposed_reports.publisher: National Planning Council / National Statistics Center, State of Qatar
proposed_reports.description: Successor statistical authority following 2024 Amiri Decision replacing Planning and Statistics Authority (PSA); official source for Qatar statistics, national accounts, CPI and data strategy implementation.

proposed_reports.title: Qatar Consumer Price Index (CPI)
proposed_reports.publisher: National Planning Council / National Statistics Center
proposed_reports.description: Monthly CPI (base year 2018) released by the National Planning Council; tracks price changes (e.g. June 2026).

proposed_reports.title: National Centre for Statistics and Information (NCSI)
proposed_reports.publisher: National Centre for Statistics and Information, Sultanate of Oman
proposed_reports.description: Official national statistics office of Oman (established by Royal Decree); responsible for national accounts, CPI, population and official statistical publications including Statistical Yearbook.

proposed_reports.title: Oman National Accounts (GDP and related)
proposed_reports.publisher: National Centre for Statistics and Information (NCSI)
proposed_reports.description: National accounts series including GDP, production accounts, with 2018 base year; covers annual and quarterly data.

proposed_reports.title: Information & eGovernment Authority (iGA) — Statistics and Population Registry Sector
proposed_reports.publisher: Information & eGovernment Authority, Kingdom of Bahrain
proposed_reports.description: Official body responsible for economic and social statistics, national accounts, CPI, population registry and open data portal in Bahrain; publishes under e-GDDS framework.

proposed_reports.title: Bahrain National Accounts / GDP
proposed_reports.description: National accounts and GDP estimates updated with ISIC Rev. 4 classification; published via NSDP and statistical releases.

proposed_reports.title: Bahrain Consumer Price Index (CPI)
proposed_reports.description: Monthly CPI series disseminated by iGA as part of macroeconomic statistics.

dependencies.basis: DoS national accounts are compiled according to SNA 2008 concepts and definitions; production accounts follow SNA 2008; Supply-Use and Input-Output Tables built consistent with SNA 2008.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The DOS statistics are in general based on the concepts and definitions recommended by 2008 system National Accounts (SNA 2008). Production accounts follow SNA 2008.

dependencies.basis: CPI uses the international Classification of Individual Consumption according to Purpose (COICOP) for goods and services classification and weights from household surveys.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The international Classification of Individual Consumption according to Purpose (COICOP) is used in addition to other international methodologies and recommendations.

dependencies.basis: Jordan participates in the IMF Special Data Dissemination Standard (SDDS); national accounts and CPI are disseminated under SDDS requirements with specified timeliness.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Special Data Dissemination Standard ... Jordan National accounts ... Last Certified: Jan 07, 2026

dependencies.basis: CPI is one of the indicators published monthly in accordance with the Special Data Dissemination Standard (SDDS).
dependencies.evidence_quote: As for the dissemination dates, the Consumer Price Index (CPI) is one of the indicators published monthly in accordance with the Special Data Dissemination Standard (SDDS) in the local and world press. Dissemination deadline is ten days after end of the reference month.

dependencies.basis: CAS explicitly states that the methodology used for national accounts estimates is based on the System of National Accounts (SNA) 2008.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The methodology used is based on the System of National Accounts (SNA) 2008.

dependencies.basis: Kuwait participates in the enhanced General Data Dissemination System (e-GDDS); Central Bank of Kuwait hosts NSDP linked to DSBB for CSB data categories including national accounts and CPI.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Data linked from this page correspond to data described in the International Monetary Fund’s DSBB. For a fuller explanation of the DSBB and the enhanced General Data Dissemination System in which State of Kuwait participates, please visit the DSBB home page.

dependencies.basis: CSB national accounts compilation framework is the 1993 System of National Accounts (with noted plans/movement toward 2008 SNA).
dependencies.evidence_quote: The framework for the compilation of national accounts is the "1993 System of National Accounts" ("1993 SNA").

dependencies.basis: Kuwait is a member state of the GCC; CSB contributes to and participates in GCC-Stat regional statistical activities and harmonisation as one of the six GCC national statistical centres.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Member States GCC Countries: United Arab Emirates, Kingdom of Bahrain, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Sultanate of Oman, State of Qatar, State of Kuwait

dependencies.basis: NCSI applied the System of National Accounts (SNA) 2008 with 2018 as new base year; implemented ISIC Rev.4 and product classifications consistent with international standards.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The Sultanate applied the new system of National Accounts (SNA) approved by the United Nations Bureau of Statistics and the United Nations Economic and Social Council in 2008. The new system adopted 2018 as a new base year for (SNA) in Oman instead of 2010.

dependencies.basis: Oman participates in e-GDDS; NCSI NSDP links data to IMF DSBB under the enhanced General Data Dissemination System.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Data linked from this page correspond to data described in the International Monetary Fund’s DSBB. For a fuller explanation of the DSBB and the enhanced General Data Dissemination System in which Country participates, please visit the DSBB home page.

dependencies.basis: Oman is a GCC member state; NCSI participates in GCC-Stat as the national statistical centre for regional harmonisation and data sharing.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Member States GCC Countries: United Arab Emirates, Kingdom of Bahrain, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Sultanate of Oman, State of Qatar, State of Kuwait

dependencies.basis: Bahrain participates in e-GDDS; iGA launched and maintains the National Summary Data Page (NSDP) in line with IMF e-GDDS standards and is working toward SDDS subscription conditions.
dependencies.evidence_quote: This page displays important economic and financial data for the Kingdom of Bahrain published as per the Dissemination Standards Bulletin Board (DSBB) of the International Monetary Fund (IMF).

dependencies.basis: Bahrain is a GCC member; iGA participates in GCC Statistics Day and GCC-Stat coordination activities as the national statistical authority.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The Information and eGovernment Authority (iGA) marked GCC Statistics Day ... alongside the GCC Statistical Center and statistical authorities across the Gulf region

dependencies.basis: Qatar implemented IMF e-GDDS with National Summary Data Page (previously under PSA, continued under successor); data disseminated under e-GDDS framework.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Qatar has launched a National Summary Data Page (NSDP) in implementing the recommendations of the IMF’s Enhanced General Data Dissemination System (e-GDDS).

dependencies.basis: Qatar is a GCC member state; its statistical authority participates in GCC-Stat regional statistical system.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Member States GCC Countries: United Arab Emirates, Kingdom of Bahrain, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Sultanate of Oman, State of Qatar, State of Kuwait
